donate.intro: Care for the temple in Kharkiv, vegetarian food and our programmes are possible thanks to donations. Thank you sincerely for your support!
donate.purposeNote: In the payment purpose, state which programme or campaign you are supporting (for example, the name used on the “All support options” page).

donationTerms.lead: Below is a short summary of what you agree to when you leave a gift for the community or make a bank transfer.
donationTerms.bodyHtml:
1. Voluntary gift and purpose

Your donation is a voluntary financial contribution to the Religious Community “Hare Krishna Temple” (ISKCON) in Kharkiv. You choose the amount; in the payment details it helps to name the programme or fund you wish to support (see the full list of options).

2. Use of funds

Donations are used for the religious and social mission of the community: temple programmes, outreach, premises, and equipment, according to the community’s current plans and priorities.

3. Personal data

Contact details you provide may be used to thank you, to follow up about your gift, and for occasional community news—without spam. We do not sell or hand them to third parties for external marketing. For any question about data processing, use the temple contact page.

4. Bank transfer

Current account details are on the Donation details page. Please include a clear payment purpose so we can match your transfer.

donationForm.supportBoxHtml: Something went wrong? Contact us.
donationForm.infoP1: If you leave your contact details, we can send a thank-you from the Deities — mahā-prasādam. We’ll only send helpful updates, no spam.
donationForm.infoP2: You can also donate anonymously — a little faster, but without that warm follow-up after your gift.
donationForm.termsHtml: I accept the donation terms and consent to the processing of my personal data.

donationMohini.intro: Your support helps us prepare for Mohini Ekadashi: service, flowers, a welcoming atmosphere, and a peaceful mood in the hall. Thank you for sharing this mercy with the community.
donationMohini.purposeNote: In the payment details, include: “Mohini Ekadashi” (optionally the year).

donationNarasimha.intro: Support the celebration of Lord Narasimha’s day: the programme, decorations, and the community’s prayer together. Every contribution is part of a shared offering.
donationNarasimha.purposeNote: In the payment details, include: “Narasimha Chaturdashi”.

donationAnnadan.intro: Donations for vegetarian food distribution and charity outreach. Together we share prasādam and warmth with more people.

donationCow.intro: Support feed, care, and veterinary needs — cow seva is a meaningful part of the community’s life.
donationCow.purposeNote: In the payment details, include: “Cow care”.

donationLectures.intro: Your help keeps daily Śrīmad Bhāgavatam sessions going and makes lectures available online, wherever you are.
donationLectures.purposeNote: In the payment details, include: “Lectures / broadcast”.

donationEducation.intro: Donations go toward materials, welcome meetings for newcomers, Bhagavad-gītā study, and a space to ask questions about bhakti.

donationKirtan.intro: Support kirtan, temple events, and special gatherings: sound, logistics, and hospitality for those who come to chant.
donationKirtan.purposeNote: In the payment details, include: “Kirtan / events”.

donationPrasadam.intro: Help with prasādam preparation, tea, and a restful area after the programme — hospitality is a shared service.
donationPrasadam.purposeNote: In the payment details, include: “Prasādam / hospitality”.

education.p1: At the Hare Krishna temple in Kharkiv we host Śrīmad Bhāgavatam lectures, Bhagavad-gītā study circles, newcomers’ meetings and the step-by-step School of bhakti — an introduction to devotional service and Vedic culture.
education.p2Html: For up-to-date times and topics, see the schedule. Some lectures are streamed online — see Broadcast. If you are new, the Sunday programme is a good start, together with the School of bhakti page. You can reach us via Contacts.
education.p3: We are happy to talk about mantra, vegetarian food and the basics of Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavism — after the programme in the hall or by message.
